title: The Blessing They Spoke
question: What is God promising when His name is spoken over His people?
blurb: The oldest blessing in Scripture, and the verses that fill in what it means.

nodes.content: What is God promising when His name is spoken over His people?

nodes.verseText: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you; may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you; may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
